objects.description: No custom data types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. It only contains version macros and function declarations.

functions.name: gtk_get_major_version
functions.description: Returns the GTK library’s major version number that the program is running against. Typically used for displaying version info or conditional logic based on runtime GTK version. Details about threading or initialization requirements are not stated in this header.
requirements: May be called at any time; no explicit initialization requirements are stated.
Return value is an unsigned integer representing the runtime major version.

functions.name: gtk_get_minor_version
functions.description: Returns the GTK library’s minor version number at runtime. Useful for conditional feature checks or diagnostics. Threading/initialization requirements are not specified here.
requirements: May be called at any time; no explicit initialization requirements are stated.
Return value is an unsigned integer representing the runtime minor version.

functions.name: gtk_get_micro_version
functions.description: Returns the GTK library’s micro (patch) version number at runtime. Used for fine-grained version checks or reporting. No additional behavioral guarantees are documented in this header.
requirements: May be called at any time; no explicit initialization requirements are stated.
Return value is an unsigned integer representing the runtime micro version.

functions.name: gtk_get_binary_age
functions.description: Returns GTK’s binary age value at runtime (a monotonically increasing number used for compatibility tracking). Typically relevant for tooling or low-level compatibility checks rather than application-level logic. Specific semantics are not documented in this header.
requirements: May be called at any time; no explicit initialization requirements are stated.
Return value is an unsigned integer representing the runtime binary age.

functions.name: gtk_get_interface_age
functions.description: Returns GTK’s interface age value at runtime (used alongside binary age for compatibility/versioning). The precise interpretation is not provided in this header.
requirements: May be called at any time; no explicit initialization requirements are stated.
Return value is an unsigned integer representing the runtime interface age.

functions.name: gtk_check_version
functions.signature: const char * gtk_check_version (unsigned required_major, unsigned required_minor, unsigned required_micro);
functions.description: Checks whether the running GTK version meets or exceeds the specified required_major.required_minor.required_micro. Returns NULL if the requirement is satisfied; otherwise returns a constant human-readable string describing the mismatch. Typical usage is to gate features or fail fast when a minimum GTK version is needed.
requirements: required_major, required_minor, and required_micro must be representable as unsigned integers.
Interpretation is as version components; no negative values are possible due to unsigned types.
On success (requirement met), the return is NULL; callers must check for NULL before using the message.
On failure (requirement not met), the returned pointer refers to read-only storage (const); do not modify or free it.
